metadata.title: Capgo Live Update status | Delivery trends
metadata.description: Global Live Update success trends for iOS and Android. Rates use the last 30 days of app, device, and UTC-day outcomes, not live queue counts and not realtime.

blocks.text: Global install success for the last 30 days. Each rate is one app, device, and UTC day, not a live queue, and not a build count.
Chart ranges up to 90 UTC days (3M). Headline KPIs above use the last 30 days. The sparkline is the last 30 UTC days, green at 60% or better.
Hourly or daily iOS and Android success, depending on the selected window. Use 1D, 1W, 1M, or 3M to change the chart range. This chart is not a live feed.

props.aria-label: Install success trend values. Move pointer across the chart or use arrow keys.

blocks.text: Download success for the last 30 days. Zip is a full bundle. Delta is a manifest of changed files. No volume counts.
Share of active devices, success rate, and leading failure by country. Success uses app/device/UTC-day outcomes.
Share of active devices, success rate, and leading failure by platform. Success uses app/device/UTC-day outcomes.

Many failures are normal on real devices: flaky networks, intentional channel policies, and automatic rollbacks all show up here. We keep the list public so you can
            trust the numbers.
Share of active devices, success rate, and leading failure by updater version. Success uses app/device/UTC-day outcomes.
Every metric on this page comes from apps that ship with Capgo.
